items.title: Joseph "Fan" Bourgeau Interview, 1959-09-24
items.q: Oh, well Ida Jackson used to play with us too, Burbank.

ctx.x: I knew he played with Joe Oliver in different lines at the time. That's the man.

He looked like an Indian fellow. He had straight black hair and he played the violin. That was Valto. He lived on St. Peter and Praia, them days. That's a long time. And who else? Well they used to have, you know they used to have pianos in all those places, you know? Oh yeah. About those. That fellow's a lot. We used to play for, what's that woman's name? Ida Jackson. Oh yeah. I played a many jobs there.
Ida Jackson, did she have a house? Did she have one of the language ladies?
